title: Checkpoint 4 — Make It Glow (RGB LED)
description: Quick check after Build #3: wiring the RGB LED and mixing colors.

questions.prompt: Each color leg of the RGB LED gets its own resistor. What value do we use?
questions.explanation: 220 Ω limits the current so the LED is bright but doesn't burn out. (The 10 kΩ was for the DHT22.)

questions.prompt: The longest leg of our RGB LED is the common cathode. Where does it connect?
questions.explanation: Common cathode = the shared negative leg, so it goes straight to GND (no resistor on this leg).
PWM blinks the LED faster than your eye can see to fake different brightness levels.

questions.prompt: What color does setColor(255, 255, 0) produce? (red, green, blue)
questions.explanation: Full red + full green + no blue mixes to yellow. Mixing channels makes new colors!

questions.prompt: Which pins drive the Red, Green, and Blue channels in our wiring?
questions.explanation: Red = GPIO 18, Green = GPIO 19, Blue = GPIO 23, each through a 220 Ω resistor.
